mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_rating_snapshot (user_id, platform, rating, max_rating, `rank`, snapshot_date) VALUES (#{userId}, #{platform}, #{rating}, #{maxRating}, #{rank}, #{snapshotDate}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rating = VALUES(rating), max_rating = VALUES(max_rating), `rank` = VALUES(`rank`)
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, platform, rating, max_rating, `rank`, snapshot_date, created_time FROM user_rating_snapshot WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC, platform

SELECT id, user_id, platform, rating, max_rating, `rank`, snapshot_date, created_time FROM user_rating_snapshot WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND platform = #{platform} ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_id, platform, rating, max_rating, `rank`, snapshot_date, created_time FROM user_rating_snapshot WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND platform = #{platform} AND snapshot_date = #{snapshotDate} LIMIT 1
